questions.question: Explain in detail the concept of LMS platforms. Discuss Google Classroom, Moodle, and their importance in digital learning.
questions.solution_html:
• Classroom, Moodle, and their importance in digital learning. (15 Marks)
  • A Learning Management System (LMS) is a software application or web-based platform
  • used to plan, deliver, manage, track, and assess educational courses and training
  • programs. It provides a centralized environment where teachers can create and distribute
  • learning materials, while students can access content, submit assignments, participate in
  • discussions, and monitor their progress.
  • Features of LMS
  • • Course management
  • • Assignment handling
  • • Assessment tools
  • • Progress tracking
  • Google Classroom
  • • Features and educational applications
  • Moodle
  • • Features and educational applications
  • Importance in digital learning
  • • Accessibility, flexibility, collaboration, and efficient learning management
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: • Accessibility, flexibility, collaboration, and efficient learning management
